title: Artificial Intelligence Developer
bio: I am Kemal. I graduated from Kastamonu University, Department of Mathematics in 2022. After graduating, I set myself the goal of applying the knowledge from my mathematics background to areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and image processing. In line with this goal, I explore AI algorithms through personal projects, online courses, and practical applications specific to image processing, developing projects that involve tasks such as image detection, recognition, and interpretation. Through this hands-on work, I have deepened my understanding of AI concepts and gained experience in turning my technical skills into concrete projects. My goal is to continue developing these skills and contribute to real-world AI solutions.

btk7: Delivered face-to-face AI training (Python, ML, deep learning, computer vision) to 20+ participants using a hands-on curriculum built on TensorFlow, OpenCV and GPU-accelerated model training demos, guiding students through end-to-end model development from data preparation to deployment with an 85% project completion rate.
calorin3: Developed a real-time food volume estimation system using YOLOv8 and OpenCV for pixel-level segmentation of fruits and vegetables, applying geometric calculations to convert segmented areas into calorie estimates with an optimised low-latency inference pipeline validated across diverse lighting and scale conditions.
ultralytics3: Produced a sponsored LinkedIn post and a YouTube tutorial for the Ultralytics Platform launch, demonstrating the full computer vision pipeline (annotation → training → export → deployment) using YOLO on two original real-world datasets.
project1info: This project implements the fascinating Kaprekar Constant (6174) discovered by Indian mathematician D.R. Kaprekar in 1949. Features iterative arithmetic operations that converge any four-digit number to 6174 within 7 steps, plus three-digit variant (495). Built with Python for educational exploration of number theory.
project2: Data Visualization of Turkey Population with Plotly
project2info: This project implements comprehensive data visualization of Turkey's population from 1927 to 2023 using Plotly and Folium. Features interactive charts, geographic maps, and demographic analysis across 81 provinces with gender distribution trends and historical comparisons.
project3: Garbage Classification with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
project3info: This project implements a Garbage Classification System using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with TensorFlow/Keras. Classifies waste into 6 categories (cardboard, glass, metal, paper, plastic, trash) using the TrashNet dataset. Achieves 62.2% accuracy with real-time image prediction capabilities for automated recycling applications.
project4info: This project implements a Facial Expression Recognition System using deep learning with VGG19 architecture. Classifies 7 emotions (angry, disgust, fear, happy, neutral, sad, surprise) from grayscale facial images. Achieves 66.33% accuracy on FER-2013 dataset with transfer learning and data augmentation techniques.
project5info: This project implements a real-time Road Lane Detection System using computer vision techniques. Features Canny edge detection, ROI masking, and Hough Transform to identify road lane markings in video streams. Processes visual data for accurate lane boundary detection with OpenCV and Python for ADAS and autonomous driving applications.
project6: Face Detection and Person Recognition System
project6info: This project implements a versatile Face Detection and Person Recognition System combining OpenCV Haar Cascade classifiers for face detection with custom-trained Ultralytics YOLO models for person recognition. It provides a modular toolkit for detecting faces and identifying specific individuals in both static media (images, videos) and real-time webcam streams.
project7: Pose Detection with YOLOv8 using Wolfram Mathematica
project7info: This project implements Pose Detection using YOLOv8 within Wolfram Mathematica. Features real-time human pose estimation with 17 keypoint detection, skeleton visualization, and comprehensive analysis tools. Leverages pre-trained models from Ultralytics for accurate body pose recognition and movement tracking.
project8info: This project implements a real-time Vehicle Speed Estimation System using YOLOv8 object detection and perspective transformation. Tracks multiple vehicles within a defined ROI, calculates speeds in km/h using geometric principles, and provides annotated video output for traffic monitoring and analysis applications.
project9: Traffic Signs Recognition, Vehicle Plate and Person Blurring System

project9_5: Blurring of Vehicle Plates and Person
project9_6: Recognition of Traffic Signs, Blurring of Vehicle Plates and Person
project9info: This project implements a comprehensive computer vision system for real-time traffic sign recognition (24 classes) with automatic privacy protection through vehicle plate and person blurring. Built with YOLOv11 models, it's designed for autonomous vehicles and GDPR-compliant surveillance applications.
project10info: This project implements a real-time Safety Lane Violation Detection System using YOLOv12 object detection and tracking. Monitors emergency lane usage, detects vehicles crossing safety boundaries, and provides live violation statistics with color-coded visualization for traffic enforcement applications.
project11_2: Vehicle Distance Measurement in Region of Interest
project11info: This project implements a real-time Vehicle Distance Measurement System using YOLOv12 and perspective geometry. Calculates distances to surrounding vehicles in three ROI lanes with adaptive warning thresholds, automatic license plate blurring for privacy, and color-coded safety indicators for dashcam applications.
project12: Road Surface Obstacle and Traffic Warning Object Segmentation System
project12_1: Road Surface Obstacle and Traffic Warning Object
project12_2: Road Surface Obstacle and Traffic Warning Object Segmentation
project12info: This project implements a real-time Road Surface Obstacle and Traffic Warning Object Segmentation System using a custom-trained YOLO26x-seg segmentation model. Detects and segments 5 classes: pothole, crack, patch (road surface obstacles) and traffic-cone, road-barrier (traffic warning objects), with per-class colored masks, anti-aliased contour outlines, and instance-level confidence labels for ADAS and autonomous driving applications.
project13info: This project implements a real-time Industrial Safety Gear Detection System using a custom-trained YOLO26x model. Detects workers and classifies PPE compliance status (helmet, safety vest, gloves, face mask) with color-coded visualization and warning banners for non-compliant workers in industrial environments.
project14: Vehicle and Pedestrian Traffic Analysis System
project14info: This project implements a real-time, zone-aware Vehicle and Pedestrian Traffic Analysis System in native C++, combining a VisDrone-trained YOLO26x detector with a from-scratch BoT-SORT multi-object tracker. Tracks and classifies road users across 10 crosswalk/road/sidewalk zones, producing per-zone occupancy and dwell-time statistics, crosswalk safety masking, a live dashboard, annotated video, CSV time series, and JSON summary output.
project15: Vehicle Plates Detection and Reading System
project15info: This project implements a real-time Vehicle Plates Detection and Reading System that combines a custom-trained RF-DETR detector with an ONNX-based Fast Plate OCR engine. It detects license plates in traffic footage, reads and validates Turkish plates with confidence-based filtering and IoU tracking that locks in each plate's reading across frames, and produces annotated video output for automatic license plate recognition (ALPR) applications.
